name: Red Skull (Classic)
description: Johann Schmidt, the Red Skull, has endured since World War II as Captain America's most dangerous nemesis. With Arnim Zola's twisted science and Baron Zemo's aristocratic cruelty at his side, the Skull plots to reshape the world in HYDRA's image.
flavorText: The Skull endures. Empires fall, but hate lives forever.
musicAIPrompt: Create a 45-second seamless loopable orchestral film score in the exact style of John Williams. Villain Entrance / Imperial March. WWII-era Red Skull and HYDRA. Nazi-style march gone cosmic. Menacing and enduring, wide stereo, instrumental only, perfectly loopable with no fade in/out.
